blurb: Counted amongst the complement of many Navis Imperialis vessels, Navy Breachers are elite Voidsmen who are outfitted, trained and endlessly drilled in boarding actions and void-based combat. Wielding a wide array of cutting gear, boarding shields and close-range weapons, they are well-suited to deadly combat in close confines.
lore: Every Navy vessel carries armsmen for the day something gets aboard, and the day always comes. Breachers fight in corridors, in the dark, in atmospheres that are venting, against boarders who have exactly the same job. They are not soldiers and do not pretend to be — they are ship's crew with shotguns and a chart of every bulkhead between here and the reactor.

source.notes: Operative stats, weapon profiles, actions, ploys and equipment transcribed from Wahapedia. Ranged weapons without a printed Range rule are given range 48 (effectively unlimited on a Kill Team board). Consult the official source for the current rules: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/downloads/kill-team/

selectionRules: 1 IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER SERGEANT-AT-ARMS operative with the following option: Navis shotgun and Navis hatchet; Or one option from each of the following: Bolt pistol or heirloom autopistol; Chainsword or power weapon

10 IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operatives selected from the following list: ARMSMAN; AXEJACK; C.A.T. UNIT*; ENDURANT; GHEISTSKULL*; GRENADIER; GUNNER with Navis las-volley and gun butt; GUNNER with meltagun and gun butt; GUNNER with plasma gun and gun butt; HATCHCUTTER; SURVEYOR; VOID-JAMMER

operatives.name: Navis Sergeant-At-Arms
operatives.lore: He has held sections of his own ship against things that came out of the warp, and he plans a boarding action the way he plans a fire drill.

operatives.name: Navis Armsman
operatives.lore: Shotgun, flak, and a working knowledge of which way the corridor bends. He fights at the range his ship was built at.

operatives.name: Navis Axejack
operatives.lore: Boarding axe and the shoulders for it. In a space this narrow the axe is simply the better weapon and everyone knows it.

operatives.name: Navis C.A.T. Unit
operatives.lore: A tracking servo-construct that scuttles ahead through ducting and reports what is on the other side. Expendable, and treated so.

abilities.name: SPOT
abilities.description: Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Until the end of the turning point, until that enemy operative is no longer visible to this operative or until this operative performs this action again (whichever comes first), whenever a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative is shooting that enemy operative, you can use this effect. If you do:That friendly operative's ranged weapons have the Seek Light weapon rule.That enemy operative cannot be obscured.This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

action.notes: "cannot be obscured" is read as Seek Light: this engine does not model obscured separately from cover

operatives.name: Navis Endurant
operatives.lore: Armoured for the point of a boarding wedge and trained to keep walking into fire. He is the reason the wedge has a point.

operatives.name: Navis Gheistskull
operatives.lore: A servo-skull with a floodlamp and a sensor package, sent down the dark half of the passage first.

abilities.name: BOOST
abilities.description: The next time this operative performs a Charge action during this activation, add 4" to the distance it can move (instead of 2"). This operative cannot perform this action more than once per battle, and cannot perform it during the first turning point.

operatives.name: Navis Grenadier
operatives.lore: In a corridor a grenade is a decision about everyone in it, including your own side. He has the judgement for that.

weapons.name: Demolition charge
weapons.rulesText: Range 3", Blast 2", Heavy (Reposition only), Limited 1, Piercing 1, Saturate

operatives.name: Navis Gunner
operatives.lore: Heavy weapon in confined space — impractical, unsafe, and decisive. He gets one good angle per compartment.

operatives.name: Navis Hatchcutter
operatives.lore: He is the reason locked hatches are a delay rather than an obstacle, and he works fast because the boarding clock is real.

abilities.name: WELD SHUT
abilities.description: Select a closed hatchway (e.g. Killzone: Gallowdark) within this operative's control range. 1 additional AP must be spent for other operatives to perform the Operate Hatch action to open that hatchway. This effect ends when that hatchway is opened. Note this operative isn't affected by this effect. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or if it isn't within 1" of a closed hatchway.

abilities.name: BREACH POINT
abilities.description: Place one of your Breach markers within this operative's control range as close as possible to a terrain feature within control range of it. Whenever an operative is within 1" of that marker, it treats parts of that terrain feature that are no more than 1" thick as Accessible terrain. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or if a terrain feature isn't within its control range.

operatives.name: Navis Surveyor
operatives.lore: Auspex in a hull full of interference. He tells the sergeant where the enemy is, with appropriate error bars.

abilities.name: WAYFIND
abilities.description: SUPPORT. Select one other friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative (excluding C.A.T. UNIT or GHEISTSKULL) visible to and within 6" of this operative, or visible to and within 6" of a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER C.A.T. UNIT operative. Until the end of that operative's next activation, add 1 to its APL stat. For the purposes of the Comms Device universal equipment, the operative the distance is being determined from must control that marker. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

abilities.name: REMOTE CONTROL
abilities.description: Select one friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER C.A.T. UNIT operative. That operative can immediately perform one free action, but it cannot move more than 3" during that action. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or if a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER C.A.T. UNIT operative isn't in the killzone.

operatives.name: Navis Void-Jammer
operatives.lore: He blinds the boarders' own sensors and cuts their vox, which in a dark corridor is worth more than another gun.

weapons.name: Gheistskull detonator
weapons.rulesText: Blast 1", Lethal 4+, Limited 1, Silent, Stun, Detonate*

abilities.name: INTERFERENCE PULSE
abilities.description: Select one enemy operative visible to and within 8" of a friendly GHEISTSKULL operative. Roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if that enemy operative is a valid target for that friendly GHEISTSKULL operative: on a 3+, subtract 1 from that enemy operative's APL stat until the end of its next activation. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative, or if a friendly GHEISTSKULL operative isn't in the killzone.

factionRules.name: Void Armour
factionRules.description: Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative, if the ranged weapon in that sequence has the Blast or Torrent weapon rule (excluding weapons that have a sweeping profile), you can re-roll one of your defence dice, or up to two of your defence dice if that friendly operative is a GRENADIER. Friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operatives aren't affected by the x" Devastating x weapon rule (i.e. Devastating with a distance) unless they are the target during that sequence.

factionRules.name: Breach and Clear
factionRules.description: Once per turning point, when a ready friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative is activated, you can use this rule. If you do, select one other ready friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative visible to and within 3" of that operative. When that first friendly operative is expended, you can activate that other friendly operative before your opponent activates. When that other operative is expended, your opponent then activates as normal.

strategicPloys.name: ATTACK ORDER
strategicPloys.description: Place your Attack Order marker in the killzone. Whenever a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative within 3" of that marker is shooting, fighting or retaliating, its weapons have the Ceaseless weapon rule. In the Ready step of the next Strategy phase, remove that marker. You cannot use this ploy and the Defence Order strategy ploy during the same Strategy phase

hooks.notes: the Attack Order marker is not placed; an objective marker stands in for it

strategicPloys.name: DEFENCE ORDER
strategicPloys.description: Place your Defence Order marker in the killzone. Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative that's within 3" of that marker, you can re-roll any of your defence dice results of one result (e.g. results of 2). In the Ready step of the next Strategy phase, remove that marker. You cannot use this ploy and the Attack Order strategy ploy during the same Strategy phase.

hooks.notes: the Defence Order marker is not placed; an objective marker stands in for it

strategicPloys.name: CLOSE ASSAULT
strategicPloys.description: Whenever a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative is fighting or shooting an operative within 3" of it: Add 1 to both Dmg stats of all profiles of its Navis shotguns or Navis heavy shotguns (if any).If you roll two or more fails, you can discard one of them to retain another as a normal success instead.

hooks.notes: the dice-discard half of the ploy is not simulated

strategicPloys.name: BRACE FOR COUNTERATTACK
strategicPloys.description: Whenever an operative is shooting against, fighting against or retaliating against a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative that's within your territory or that hasn't performed the Charge, Fall Back or Reposition action during this turning point, Normal and Critical Dmg of 3 or more inflicts 1 less damage on that friendly operative.

hooks.notes: territory and the "hasn't moved this turning point" condition are not checked, and the 3+ damage threshold is not applied

firefightPloys.name: OVERWHELM TARGET
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when you activate either friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative while using the Breach and Clear faction rule. Until the end of that operative's activation, add 1 to its APL stat.

hooks.notes: the Breach and Clear faction rule is not simulated, so any operative may buy this

firefightPloys.name: BLITZ
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative performs the Shoot or Fight action, and you select an enemy operative within 6" of it as a valid target or to fight against. If it's the first friendly operative to perform either of those actions during this turning point, its weapons have the Accurate 1 weapon rule for that action. If it's the first friendly operative to be activated during this turning point, its weapons also have the Severe weapon rule for that action.

hooks.notes: the extra Severe for the first operative activated is not simulated

firefightPloys.name: LOCK IT DOWN
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative is activated. Select one objective marker. Until the end of the battle or until you use this ploy again (whichever comes first), when determining control of that objective marker, treat that friendly operative's APL stat as 1 higher. Note this isn't a change to the APL stat, so any changes are cumulative with this.

firefightPloys.name: DECK HAND
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy during a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative's activation, before or after it performs an action. That operative can move through one Accessible terrain feature without it counting as an additional 1" and/or perform a free Operate Hatch action during its activation, and can do so during the Charge or Fall Back action. You cannot use this ploy if the access point has been welded shut (see HATCHCUTTER) unless it's a friendly HATCHCUTTER operative's activation.

equipment.name: REBREATHERS
equipment.description: You can ignore any changes to the APL stat of friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operatives, and they aren't affected by enemy operatives' Shock weapon rule.

equipment.name: SLUGS
equipment.description: Up to three times per turning point, whenever a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative is performing the Shoot action and you select a Navis shotgun (long range), you can use this rule. If you do, until the end of that action, improve the Hit stat of that weapon by 1 and add 1 to both of its Dmg stats, and that weapon has the Accurate 1 weapon rule.

equipment.name: COMBAT STIMMS
equipment.description: You can ignore any changes to the Move stat of friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operatives from being injured.

equipment.name: SYSTEM OVERRIDE DEVICE
equipment.description: Once per turning point, one friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER operative can perform the Operate Hatch action for 1 less AP.

ruleHooks.notes: the sweeping-profile exclusion and the splash-Devastating immunity are not simulated

shield.text: Whenever this operative is fighting or retaliating with this weapon, each of your blocks can be allocated to block two unresolved successes (instead of one).

detonate.text: Don't select a valid target. Instead, a friendly IMPERIAL NAVY BREACHER GHEISTSKULL operative is always the primary target and cannot be in cover or obscured. If that operative isn't in the killzone, you cannot select this weapon.
